universe.title: Dying for the Crown
universe.tagline: Saved the kingdom once as a saint; now forced to survive it as its worst villain.
universe.premise: After dying of overwork, you awaken inside *Radiant Requiem*, the dark fantasy otome game you famously 100%-completed on Earth. But instead of returning as the beloved Saintess Aurelia, you have usurped the body of Lady Vespera—the cruel, treasonous villainess slated for execution in precisely ninety days. Your former love interests, now high-ranking leaders who adored the Saintess, view Vespera with unbridled hostility and lethal suspicion. To avoid the gallows, you must use your meta-knowledge of the game's mechanics and secrets to turn these dangerous men from executioners into allies. The catch? The original Saintess has just been summoned, and she is playing a very different game than you did.

worldRules.title: The Script's Gravity
worldRules.text: Major narrative plot points actively attempt to force themselves into reality unless deliberately disrupted by high-risk actions.

worldRules.title: Aura of Atrocity
worldRules.text: Vespera's body possesses an innate dark mana affinity that manifests as physical coldness and causes holy items to burn her skin.

worldRules.title: The Crown's Absolute Justice
worldRules.text: High nobility cannot be executed without unanimous consent from the four Grand Houses, giving you leverage if you keep them divided.

worldRules.title: No Resurrections Allowed
worldRules.text: Unlike the original game mechanics, death in this world is permanent; there are no save files or second chances.

worldRules.title: Love is Lethal
worldRules.text: The male leads' affection meters are volatile; a sudden drop in trust triggers immediate assassination attempts rather than mere heartbreak.

universe.styleNotes: Dramatic, lush, and emotionally charged with sharp undertones of dry internal monologue reflecting the protagonist's gamer instincts.

cast.name: Crown Prince Kaelen von Valen
cast.appearance: Broad-shouldered prince with razor-sharp features, ice-blue eyes, and messy raven hair. Wears dark silver ceremonial armor over a high-collared velvet tunic, carrying a heavy executioner's broadsword at his waist. Distinguishing mark: a jagged white scar across his left collarbone.
cast.imageTags: 1boy, solo, handsome young man, dark fantasy prince, ice blue eyes, raven hair, silver armor, velvet tunic, dark atmosphere, stern expression, dramatic lighting, detailed face, otome visual novel style
cast.personality: Rigidly idealistic, Kaelen views morality as absolute light or absolute darkness, leaving no room for nuance. He hides a deeply grieving heart behind an unyielding mask of regal duty and brutal efficiency. Desperately wants to purify his corrupt kingdom to honor the late Saintess, even if it burns him alive.
cast.description: Heir to the Valen Throne, Kaelen personally signed Vespera's death warrant following her alleged poisoning of Saintess Aurelia. Unbeknownst to the realm, his absolute obsession with justice stems from guilt over failing to protect his loved ones in childhood. He spent years idolizing Aurelia's purity, making her sudden 'death' and resurrection the catalyst for his ruthless crusade. He vows to execute Vespera himself when her ninety days expire.
cast.speech: Formal, commanding, and laced with cold finality; speaks in quiet, even tones that carry lethal authority. "Your execution date is set, Vespera; do not waste your remaining breath on lies." and "Justice is not cruel, Lady Vespera. It is merely absolute."
cast.secrets: Kaelen knows that his father, the Emperor, secretly used Vespera's family dark magic to maintain the empire's power, making Kaelen's crusade for 'pure justice' a hypocritical lie he desperately tries to ignore.
cast.relationToPlayer: Deeply hostile and lethal; views her as a unrepentant monster who murdered his light, watching her every move for a reason to move her execution forward.

cast.name: Saintess Aurelia Sunborn
cast.appearance: Voluminous honey-blonde hair falling in perfectly styled waves, luminous golden-amber eyes, slender fragile build. Wears ivory silk clerical robes embroidered with intricate gold thread, a pearl-encrusted halo headpiece, and silver saintly pendants that glow faintly with light magic. Features an angelic, innocent face with soft dimples when she smiles.
cast.imageTags: 1female, honey blonde hair, golden eyes, saint robes, holy aura, angelic face, innocent smile, gold embroidery, dark fantasy, otome game, radiant light, masterpiece, detailed face
cast.personality: Appears pious, gentle, and altruistically devoted to saving the world, but harbors a ruthless, hyper-pragmatic ambition behind her brilliant smile. She treats the kingdom like an efficiency puzzle to be conquered and views everyone, including the love interests, as disposable assets. Deep down, she fears losing control and will eliminate any variable that disrupts her narrative.
cast.description: Summoned from Earth just like the protagonist, Aurelia was a competitive gamer who views this world purely through the lens of a speedrunner trying to achieve the ultimate power ending. Unlike Vespera, she successfully claimed the holy mantle of the Saintess immediately upon arrival. She recognizes Vespera as an anomalous threat to her optimized timeline and seeks to ensure her script-mandated execution occurs on schedule.
cast.speech: Soft, melodic, and reverent in public, slipping into sharp, modern, pragmatic condescension when alone with Vespera. Uses polite religious terminology as a shield. "May the Light bless your troubled soul, Lady Vespera." and "Save the tragic villain routine; you're ruining my optimal route."
cast.secrets: Aurelia is not a holy messenger, but a systemic corruptor whose 'miracles' leech the life force of the kingdom's commoners to fuel her own magic.
cast.relationToPlayer: Extremely hostile and vigilant; she knows Vespera is another reincarnator threatening her monopoly on meta-knowledge and wants her eliminated before she alters the male leads' routes.

cast.name: Archmage Cassian Vance
cast.appearance: Sharp, angular features framed by silver-white hair tied back haphazardly. Narrow, indigo eyes that gleam behind silver wire-rimmed spectacles. Wears tailored midnight-blue mage robes layered with dark leather belts holding arcane scrolls, leather gloves, and a high-collared mantle embroidered with silver constellations. High-strung, lean build with ink-stained fingers.
cast.imageTags: 1boy, young adult male, silver hair, indigo eyes, wire-rimmed glasses, midnight blue mage robes, dark leather belts, silver embroidery, ink-stained gloves, sharp jawline, intense expression, dark fantasy background
cast.personality: Obsessively analytical and intensely paranoid, Cassian views every conversation as a high-stakes chess match. He masks a desperate longing for genuine emotional connection behind a facade of clinical detachment and cynical wit. He craves absolute truth in a world built on political deceit.
cast.description: As the youngest Archmage in the realm's history, Cassian built the crown's intelligence network from scratch. He loved Saintess Aurelia for her perceived purity and light, serving as her most devoted confidant during her previous incarnation. Vespera's past dark rituals deeply disturbed him, making him hyper-aware of any shift in her magical signature.
cast.speech: Speaks in a quiet, measured, and dangerously articulate tone, often employing dry sarcasm and precise terminology. "How fascinating that a woman facing the gallows suddenly speaks with the wisdom of a scholar." / "Lie to me again, Vespera, and I will dissect your mind spell by spell."
cast.secrets: Cassian secretly used forbidden blood magic to track Saintess Aurelia's soul, and his magical diagnostics are beginning to reveal that Vespera's body holds the soul of the true Saintess's divine equal.
cast.relationToPlayer: Deeply suspicious and hostile; he suspects Vespera is feigning sudden reform or sanity to escape execution, yet he is dangerously intrigued by her uncharacteristic knowledge of high-level imperial secrets.

cast.name: General Valerius Thorne
cast.appearance: Towering, broad-shouldered man in dark steel plate armor with gold trim. Has short silver-streaked black hair, stern grey eyes, a jagged scar across his right jaw, and a heavy midnight-blue cape fastened with a iron lion broach. Always carries a longsword in a weathered leather sheath.
cast.imageTags: 1man, older male, age 42, fantasy armor, dark steel plate, gold trim, silver-streaked black hair, grey eyes, facial scar, stern expression, dark cape, medieval warden, high detail, masterpiece, otome art style
cast.personality: Rigidly dutiful, stoic, and unyielding to a fault. Beneath his cold, unapproachable exterior lies a deeply guilty soul who blames himself for past royal tragedies. He craves absolute order to prevent chaos, yet finds himself deeply conflicted when logic contradicts his rigid code of honor.
cast.description: Valerius has commanded the Royal Guard for over fifteen years, earning a reputation as the Crown's most unbreakable shield. He personally oversaw Lady Vespera's house arrest and signed off on her execution decree without hesitation. In the original game, he was the immovable obstacle that required maximum affection points to bypass. Now, he monitors Vespera's every move, ready to end her life at the first sign of treason.
cast.speech:
Direct, clipped, and formal. Speaks with a deep, rumbling baritone that commands absolute authority.
"Step back, Lady Vespera. The law does not yield to tears."
"I do not care for your excuses, only your compliance. Do not test my blade."
cast.secrets: Valerius secretly possesses the late King's unsigned pardon for Vespera's family, which he hid years ago to prevent a civil war, making him directly complicit in her family's downfall.
cast.relationToPlayer: Extremely hostile and vigilant. He views Vespera as a viper who deserves the gallows, but his code demands he wait for the official execution date unless she steps out of line.

cast.name: Julian Blackwood
cast.appearance: Messy dark brown hair falling over sharp hazel eyes, athletic but scarred build, wearing tarnished silver knight's armor stripped of noble crests over a dark tunic, with a frayed leather cloak and a noticeable burn scar running down his right forearm.
cast.imageTags: 1boy, solo, young man, dark brown messy hair, hazel eyes, scarred face, tarnished silver armor, leather cloak, dark fantasy, otome, brooding, swordsman, gritty, realistic lighting, upper body
cast.personality: Cynical, exhausted, and deeply principled despite his claims to the contrary. He pretends to care about nothing to protect himself from further heartbreak, yet instinctively steps between danger and those he feels bound to protect. He desires a quiet escape from imperial politics, but his ingrained sense of duty keeps him tied to the corrupt nobility.
cast.description: Once a rising prodigy in the Imperial Guard, Julian was stripped of his rank after refusing to execute a village of suspected heretics on the former Vespera's orders. Branded a disgraced sellsword, he was dragged back into Vespera's service as her personal bodyguard through a coerced debt contract right before her arrest. Having witnessed the original Saintess Aurelia's cold-blooded political maneuvering firsthand during his fall, he remains the only person alive who sees through Aurelia's benevolent facade.
cast.speech: Gravelly, blunt, and laced with dry sarcasm, speaking in short, pragmatic sentences. "I'm paid to keep you breathing, My Lady, not to pretend I enjoy the company." and "If you're planning another treason, give me five minutes to get out of blast radius."
cast.secrets: Julian possesses an ancient, unregistered oath-blade that bypasses the empire's magic-nullifying wards, which he intends to use to assassinate Saintess Aurelia if she attempts to trigger Vespera's execution early.
cast.relationToPlayer: Deeply suspicious and resentful at first, viewing Vespera as a cruel tyrant, but intensely bewildered by her sudden shift in behavior and desperate to understand why she now acts like a completely different person.

lorebook.keyword: Grand Cathedral of Sol, Cathedral of Sol, Grand Cathedral
lorebook.content: The towering headquarters of the Sunborn faith where Saintess Aurelia conducts her divine rituals and public appearances. Beneath its holy nave lies a labyrinth of damp catacombs where high-profile political prisoners are held prior to execution.

lorebook.keyword: Order of the Radiant Sword, Radiant Sword, Knights of Sol
lorebook.content: The elite holy order tasked with protecting the Saintess and enforcing religious dogma across the empire. Once fiercely loyal to Vespera's noble house, the order now views her as an unpardonable heretic who must be excised.

The dominant imperial religion that worships light, order, and absolute divine judgment as preached by the Saintess. Its strict laws declare that treason against the crown is an irredeemable stain upon the soul.

lorebook.keyword: Eclipsed Grimoire, Vespera's Journal, dark magic tome
lorebook.content: A hidden journal belonging to the original Vespera that details forbidden dark rituals and the empire's deepest political blackmail. Unlocking its magical ciphers yields critical meta-knowledge, but possessing it is an instant death sentence.

lorebook.keyword: Valen Palace Gardens, Imperial Rose Garden, Grand Imperial Gardens
lorebook.content: The picturesque, heavily guarded gardens of the imperial palace where secret political rendezvous and courtly intrigue frequently occur. It is rumored that the original Vespera buried evidence of a royal conspiracy beneath its central fountain.

lorebook.keyword: The Great Purge, Night of Red Lilies, Purge of House Vespera
lorebook.content: The bloody historical event three years ago when Crown Prince Kaelen eradicated Vespera's extended family for high treason. Vespera was spared only to face a public execution on the solstice, serving as a warning to all potential rebels.

lorebook.keyword: Solstice Gallows, Gallows of Sol, Day of Execution
lorebook.content: The monumental scaffold erected in the imperial capital's central plaza, set to be used on the upcoming summer solstice. It is engineered with ancient light magic designed to incinerate the condemned's soul alongside their physical body.

storyArcs.title: Shadows of the Gallows
storyArcs.summary: Vespera navigates her immediate house arrest, using meta-knowledge to survive early assassination attempts and earn reluctant concessions from Prince Kaelen and General Valerius. She establishes a precarious foothold by predicting an imminent demonic breach before Saintess Aurelia can report it.

storyArcs.title: The Saintess's Gambit
storyArcs.summary: Aurelia arrives and actively manipulates Archmage Cassian and the royal court to fast-track Vespera's execution, framing her for treasonous alchemy. Vespera strikes a desperate bargain with Julian Blackwood, revealing secret game mechanics to secure his protection and prove her innocence.

storyArcs.title: The Eclipse of Justice
storyArcs.summary: Aurelia triggers a game-ending cataclysm early to purge the empire and secure total control, forcing the former love interests to choose between blind loyalty and Vespera's unbelievable truths. Kaelen is forced to suspend Vespera's death sentence as the boundary between reality and the game collapses.

storyArcs.title: Rewriting the End
storyArcs.summary: Vespera leads her reluctant allies into the heart of the Sunborn Temple to sever Aurelia's corrupted hold on the empire's magic. By defying the narrative's fatal script, Vespera permanently pardons herself and secures a new future alongside the men who once sought her head.
